page_title: MAL 3-1 ELC | Mallorca v Elche 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jose Munuera didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Vedat Muriqi is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Abdon Prats (Mallorca).

89' 3 - 1 Omar Mascarell displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it into the top right corner – 3:1.
87' The game has come to an end for David Affengruber. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Josan (Elche).
87' A substitution has been made. Rafa Mir goes off and Andre Silva (Elche) comes on.

86' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Sergi Darder will be replaced by Pablo Torre (Mallorca).

82' 2 - 1 GOAL! And it’s the keeper’s mistake after his poor pass is easily intercepted by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca), who gleefully finds the net from mid range with a first time effort. That makes it 2:1.
82' A yellow card for a tackle by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca). Jose Munuera doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
82' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) and Johan Mojica perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.

78' It's time for a substitution. Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) comes on in place of Martim Neto.
76' It seemed like German Valera (Elche) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
76' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

54' The corner from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is intercepted by the defence.

53' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Inaki Pena has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Mallorca will take a corner kick.

52' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
50' The resulting free kick from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
49' German Valera (Elche) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
48' German Valera (Elche) sends an accurate short pass. David Affengruber controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
46' The whistle blows and Jose Munuera starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Elche quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

45+1' Martim Neto (Elche) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' German Valera (Elche) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

38' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Mallorca.
38' Mallorca are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
37' Elche are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
33' The Elche players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
32' It looks like Victor Chust (Elche) saw red with that tackle. Jose Munuera won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
30' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 47:53.
29' Inaki Pena displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
29' Mallorca enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
27' Elche players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
21' 1 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.

21' What a wasted opportunity by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Inaki Pena makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
20' The foul by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Munuera.

20' Yago Santiago (Elche) and Martim Neto have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
18' Alvaro Nunez (Elche) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Pedro Bigas with a fine lofted pass.
18' Neat passing move from Elche in order to create new attacking opportunities.
13' OFF THE POST! Jan Virgili (Mallorca) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
11' Elche hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
10' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mallorca.
5' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) was set free in the area by Jan Virgili and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
4' Alvaro Nunez (Elche) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
4' Mallorca seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
1' Great teamplay by Elche as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
